newsitem.title: UK: Bandt unit sells hydraulics business.
newsitem.headline: Bandt unit sells hydraulics business.

text.p: Bandt Plc, the industrial products distributor, on Tuesday announced it agreed to sell its hydraulic components business to Sanderson Hydraulics Ltd for 2.22 million stg.
Completion of the deal, which marks Bandt's exist from the hydraulic business, is expected in the second half of January.
The business, which employs 67 staff, made a pre-tax loss on ordinary operations of 0.76 million stg for the year to March 31.
The hydraulic operations failed to progress despite cost-cutting measures, Bandt said.
